_readme: Hand read from the clerk confirmed cells for cities whose sheet rows hold several sites in one cell, whose hours were typed day by day, or whose address cell was dragged down in the sheet so the street number auto incremented (Allendale 6676 to 6679, Auburn Hills 1899 to 1901; the first row is the real one, verified on the Ottawa County and City of Auburn Hills sites). Keyed by jurisdiction as the precinct name spells it. Edit here, rebuild, done.
